string.text: Shared debug logging, on-screen overlay, and feature test keys. Leave logging on if you are reporting a bug.
Queue every D.O.G.M.A. option to its built-in default (orange / pending), same as MCM Default. Accept to apply, Reset to discard. Does not touch other mods.
All D.O.G.M.A. options queued to defaults - Accept to apply.
Writes D.O.G.M.A. debug lines to xray_*.log under appdata/logs. On by default.
On-screen D.O.G.M.A. debug overlay used by features that support it.
Hold to raise body radiation smoothly (~200 mSv/s). For testing grain FX and rad systems.
Hold to lower body radiation smoothly (~200 mSv/s).
Hold to raise bleeding smoothly (~25%/s of the 0-1 scale).
Hold to lower bleeding smoothly (~25%/s of the 0-1 scale).
Hold to raise main HP smoothly (~25%/s).
Hold to lower main HP smoothly (~25%/s).
Press: +1 Body Health System point on head.
Press: -1 Body Health System point on head.
Press: +1 Body Health System point on torso.
Press: -1 Body Health System point on torso.
Press: +1 Body Health System point on left arm.
Press: -1 Body Health System point on left arm.
Press: +1 Body Health System point on right arm.
Press: -1 Body Health System point on right arm.
Press: +1 Body Health System point on left leg.
Press: -1 Body Health System point on left leg.
Press: +1 Body Health System point on right leg.
Press: -1 Body Health System point on right leg.
If a frame takes longer than this to complete, log a warning (search xray log for 'LONG FRAME WARNING!'). Requires debug logging.
If a frame takes longer than this to complete, log a warning (search xray log for 'LONG FRAME WARNING!'). 0 = off. Requires debug logging.

Master switch for dogma.perf. Every timed call is summarized in appdata/dogma_perf.log every ~10s as tick(last window) + total(while logging on; survives game load): n, n/s, min/max/avg us. Threshold only gates console/xray slow warns. Off by default — start/stop are no-ops. Independent of Enable debug logging.
Default warn threshold for dogma.perf when logging is enabled. 0 = off for calls with no per-call us. Prefer start(mod, method, us) / stop().
Default warn threshold for dogma.perf when logging is enabled (0-5000 us, step 100). 0 = off for calls with no per-call us. Prefer start(mod, method, us) / stop(). 1000 us = 1 ms.
